_about: Public-domain John MacHale (1791-1881), Catholic Archbishop of Tuam, for the Word Hoard: The Evidences and Doctrines of the Catholic Church, his Letters, Sermons and Discourses, and five sermons preached in Rome (in Italian). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 109 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

machale-sermoni-roma: Sermoni cinque predicati in Roma : nel corrente anno ecclesiastico / dall' illmo e rmo monsig. Giovanni Mac-Hale, vescovo di Maronia e coadiutore di Killala in Irlanda ; e dall'inglese recati in italiano dall'Ab. Antonino De-Luca (nel Collegio Urbano, 1832)
machale-letters: The letters of the Most Reverend John Mac Hale, D.D (Dublin : J. Duffy, 1847)
machale-sermons: Sermons and discourses (Dublin : Gill ; New York : Catholic Publication Society, 1883)
machale-evidences: The evidences and doctrines of the Catholic Church : showing that the former are no less convincing than the latter are propitious to the happiness of society (catalogued 1885)
